diff --git a/test_repair_query_search_http.py b/test_repair_query_search_http.py
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test_repair_query_search_http.py
@@ -0,0 +1,43 @@
+import json
+
+from tests.test_controllers import BaseTestCase, app, authenticated_user, query_factory
+
+
+class QuerySearchHTTPTest(BaseTestCase):
+    def test_search_returns_name_and_description_matches(self):
+        by_name = query_factory.create(
+            name='Monthly apricot revenue', description='Totals by region')
+        by_description = query_factory.create(
+            name='Cohort overview', description='Revenue from apricot orders')
+        unrelated = query_factory.create(
+            name='Retention report', description='Weekly customer activity')
+
+        with app.test_client() as client, authenticated_user(client):
+            response = client.get('/api/queries/search',
+                                  query_string={'q': 'apricot'})
+
+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.data)
+        results = json.loads(response.data)
+        self.assertIsInstance(results, list)
+        ids = set(item['id'] for item in results)
+        self.assertEqual(ids, set([by_name.id, by_description.id]))
+        self.assertNotIn(unrelated.id, ids)
+
+    def test_search_uses_the_requested_keyword(self):
+        first = query_factory.create(
+            name='Warehouse invoices', description='Invoice totals')
+        second = query_factory.create(
+            name='Shipping overview', description='Delivery delays by region')
+
+        with app.test_client() as client, authenticated_user(client):
+            for term, expected in [('invoices', first), ('delays', second)]:
+                response = client.get('/api/queries/search',
+                                      query_string={'q': term})
+                self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.data)
+                results = json.loads(response.data)
+                self.assertEqual(set(item['id'] for item in results),
+                                 set([expected.id]))
+
+
+# Expose these tests to Python 2 unittest's dotted-name .py argument.
+py = QuerySearchHTTPTest

(
bash /testbed/mimo_test_command.sh
)
REPAIR_RC=$?
cd /testbed || exit 1
if [ -x /opt/test_venv/bin/python3 ]; then
  PATH=/opt/test_venv/bin:$PATH
  export PATH
  python() { /opt/test_venv/bin/python3 "$@"; }
  python3() { /opt/test_venv/bin/python3 "$@"; }
fi
/root/.pyenv/versions/2.7.18/bin/python -m nose -v test_repair_query_search_http.py
REPAIR_NEW_RC=$?
if [ "$REPAIR_NEW_RC" -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi
exit "$REPAIR_RC"
